name: DeepInfer
cost: Free (Apache 2.0). It needs datacenter hardware: NVIDIA SM100 GPUs or Huawei Ascend 950 NPUs
works_with: Linux with NVIDIA SM100 GPUs or Huawei Ascend 950 NPUs. Runs DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
short: DeepSeek's own inference framework, released so you can run DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash offline on large GPU clusters.
what: DeepInfer is the inference framework behind DeepSeek's large-scale production services. This release does offline inference for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, with optimized kernels, several kinds of parallelism, draft-token decoding, deterministic sampling and structured outputs (regex, JSON schema or EBNF grammar). It was first built mostly on vLLM.
who: Infrastructure engineers with access to NVIDIA SM100 GPUs or Ascend 950 NPUs who want to serve DeepSeek models themselves. Skip it if you don't have that hardware. It is also not a full serving stack on its own.
needs: Python 3.12, in a new empty environment
CUDA 13 on NVIDIA, or CANN 9.2 on Ascend
NVIDIA SM100 GPUs or Huawei Ascend 950 NPUs

steps.title: Make a clean Python environment
steps.text: Get the source from the repo, then create and activate an empty Python 3.12 environment before you build.

steps.title: Build from source
steps.text: Set `DEEPINFER_ACCELERATOR` to `nvidia` or `ascend`, and keep it exported wherever you run DeepInfer.
steps.code:
# Use `ascend` instead for the Ascend platform
# Keep it exported in the environment where you run DeepInfer
export DEEPINFER_ACCELERATOR=nvidia
./build.sh

steps.title: Run offline inference
steps.text: The first run downloads the default checkpoint, `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017`, into the Hugging Face cache. To use a local copy, set `DEEPINFER_HF_MODEL_DIR` to its folder.

steps.title: Turn on extra features
steps.text: Features are switched on with environment variables. `DEEPINFER_BATCH_INVARIANT=1` keeps results the same across batch mixes (NVIDIA only), and `so_args` in `SamplingParams` constrains output to a schema. examples/README.md has the details.

try.label: From the README
try.text: Run `python examples/offline_inference.py` to generate with the default DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash checkpoint.

watch: It runs only on NVIDIA SM100 GPUs or Huawei Ascend 950 NPUs. The published benchmarks used 4 GPUs for prefill and 64 for decode.
This release is offline inference only. A complete service also needs a KV cache system, prefill and decode disaggregation, and load balancing, and none of those are included.
The first run downloads the full model checkpoint from Hugging Face.
